Final thoughts

What the week adds up to.

TraderSwift guide1 min readRead Markdown ↗

The pattern of the week was the same in every part of the system: build it, test it live, find what breaks, write down the rule that would have caught it. Lockbox became Signer, Signer traded with real money, and it moved to new machines without stopping. Most of the code was written by Codex and reviewed by a second pass.

None of it is finished. What is public has its record on chain and in Git.
